issues.description: The SPARQL constraint for draught limit cannot be parsed because the namespace prefix `nltl` is not declared in the query.
issues.suggestion: Add a PREFIX declaration for the nltl namespace (e.g. `PREFIX nltl: <https://w3id.org/nltl/vocab#>` ) at the beginning of the SPARQL SELECT block or ensure the SHACL engine inherits document‑level prefixes for SPARQL constraints.
